'''Hot Springs Hold''' is an [[Aiel]] [[hold|settlement]] in the [[Aiel Waste|Three-fold Land]]. It is owned by the [[Shaarad]] [[clan]]. [[Colinda]] is the [[Wise One]] of the hold and [[Gaul]] is from the hold.{{ref/book|4|28}}{{ref/book|4|42}}
